body_markdown:
Grace L, the crafter behind Sharky’s Leather, made Tandy’s Travel Notebook Kit with a marble dye technique and interior accents. Follow her step-by-step process to create a small personal journal perfect for wherever your next adventure takes you!


[Shop All Materials](https://tandyleather.com/collections/journal-travel-notebook-kit-with-sharkys-leather)

- [Travel Notebook Kit](https://tandyleather.com/products/travel-notebook-kit) (SKU: 4188-10) QTY: 1

Dyes, Paints & Finishes


- [Angelus Southwest Set](https://tandyleather.com/products/angelus-paint-kit-set-southwest-sunset) (SKU: 2818-02) QTY: 1
- [Fiebing's Leather Dye](https://tandyleather.com/products/fiebings-leather-dye) (SKU: 2400-XX) QTY: 1
- [Fiebing's Resolene](https://tandyleather.com/products/fiebings-acrylic-resolene?variant=45233560387715) (SKU: 2270-01) QTY: 1
- [Tokonole Burnishing Agent](https://tandyleather.com/products/tokonole-burnishing-agent) (SKU: 2621-10) QTY: 1


Additional Materials


- Aluminum foil
- Shaving Cream
- Paper Towels


**Instructions:**


Marble Dyeing Leather & Interior Design


**Step 1:** Cover your work surface with aluminum foil, roughly twice the size of your journal cover.


**Step 2:** Spread a layer of shaving cream over the foil, slightly larger than your cover so the whole piece can touch it.


**Step 3:** Dip a dauber or brush end into the dye and drop it across the shaving cream in scattered spots.


**Pro Tip:** Spread the dye around rather than leaving it in one spot allowing for easier movement and designs!


**Step 4:** Drag a brush through the dye and cream, creating swirls, lines, waves, marbling. Don't overthink this part! Experiment until you like the pattern.


**Step 5:** Gently lay the leather cover grain (smooth) side down onto the cream so the whole surface makes contact. Don't slide this around, or you'll smear the pattern!


**Step 6:** Let the dye set for 15–20 minutes. The longer this sits, the darker it gets.


**Step 7:** Remove the leather cover gently and rinse with water until the shaving cream is gone. Don't wipe this with a paper towel as that can streak your design.


**Step 8:** Let the cover dry completely for 24 to 48 hours. Don't rush this part!


**Step 9:** Once dry, apply Fiebing's Resolene to the dyed side with a dauber, spreading evenly. Wipe off the excess with a paper towel. ****


**Step 10:** Let the finish dry 1–2 hours before continuing. ****


Assembly & Finishing


**Step 1:** Pick out a design you'd like to cut into the interior portion of the journal with a swivel knife.


**Step 2:** Dampen the flesh (rough) side of the journal and place the design over it to trave with a pen.


**Step 3:** Using a swivel knife cut out the design you created.


**Step 4:** Using your complementary colors from the dyed front cover, set out your paints and brushes of choice before starting.


**Step 5:** Using thin coats, start painting, staying inside your cut lines. Use multiple coats to get the full color and clean up any missed spots!


**Step 6:** Let the paint dry for several hours or overnight before finishing.


**Step 7:** Apply the finish using a dauber or brush to apply Fiebing's Resolene over the painted, inside surface with 2–3 thin coats, letting each dry before the next.


**Step 8:** After you've allowed this to dry overnight use the buffing cloth to buff the leather for a nice shine.


**Step 9:** Apply a small amount of Tokonole along the edges, then burnish it with a wooden burnisher until the edges feel smooth. This presses the leather fibers together for a clean, finished look. Continue burnishing until you're happy with the look and feel.


**Step 10:** Follow the instructions with your kit to complete the assembly of the Travel Notebook!
